_about: Dimethyl carbonate (1) + Ethylbenzene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 93.13 kPa. source.citation: S. S. Yadav, N. A. Mali, S. S. Joshi, P. V. Chavan, Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium Data for the Binary Systems of Dimethyl Carbonate with Xylene Isomers at 93.13 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 62 (2017) 2436-2442
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
